# pve_replication_schedule_now (Action)

Schedules a replication job to start as soon as possible (`POST /nodes/{node}/replication/{id}/schedule_now`) and waits for the replication task to finish. Requires the `VM.Replicate` privilege on `/vms/{vmid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Start replication job 100-0 (guest 100) on node pve1 as soon as
# possible and wait for the replication task to finish.
action "pve_replication_schedule_now" "replicate_vm100_now" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    id   = "100-0"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Replication job ID, `<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>` (e.g. `100-0`).
- `node` (String) The cluster node the replication job is scheduled on; the task runs here.
